data.description: Resource-specific original projections and individual claim records; no merged confidence or inferred equivalence.

info.description: Release-local immutable API. Stable /api/v1 URLs redirect to a retained release. Use the final retained URL to pin pagination and dependencies. Duplicate parameters and arrays are rejected. ASCII A-Z folding only; Unicode is exact UTF-8. Confidence and provenance belong to individual claims. Search NOT subtrees have independent evidence scope. No authentication or writes. PHP query fallback: ./api-v1.php?resource=search&q=... . Public CORS exposes ETag and X-LOLDEX-Dataset; conditional responses verify consumed file hashes before 304.
info.title: LOLDEX public read-only API
